An '''Angry bear''' is a [[monster]] that appears during [[A Soul's Bane]] [[quest]], or afterwards, in [[Tolna's rift]].

During the quest, it can only be killed with the [[anger spear]]. After the quest, it can be fought with any weapon. Angry bears will count towards a [[Bears (Slayer assignment)|bears Slayer assignment]].
